visualCharacteristics.purpose: Product recommendations under a section heading (e.g. MOST POPULAR, TRENDING) shown as a horizontal slider
visualCharacteristics.description: Horizontal product slider: 2 cards visible on mobile, 5 from 768px; each card has a contained product image, a two-line-clamped product name link and a price line (regular and red bold sale price, or a 'Log in for Exchange pricing' note). Prev/next chevron arrows (from 768px) wrap around; page dots below.

contentPattern.structure: one row per product, 2 cells (Image | Product name link + price line)
contentPattern.description: Each row is one product: cell 1 the product image (optionally linked), cell 2 a paragraph with the product name linked to the product page, then a paragraph with the price ('$24.95 $19.96 Sale' is split into regular and sale price) or a pricing note. Arrows and dots are built by the block.

usage.purpose: Stand-alone horizontal product slider (image, linked product name, price) placed under a default-content heading, e.g. MOST POPULAR and TRENDING on /deals.

reuseGuidance: Use for any single list of products shown as a carousel. For several product lists switched by tabs use tabs-product-recs, which renders the same slider. For static category or deal tiles use cards-category.
